ValidationRule.description: BRD 12A: after an approved First Applicant Change the stage cannot change until the new applicant's signed Booking Form is uploaded (Signed Booking Form Uploaded true again).
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The First Applicant has been changed. Upload the Booking Form signed by the new first applicant (Document Type "Signed Booking Form") and mark "Signed Booking Form Uploaded" before changing the booking stage.
